description: Remove job matches from the user's saved list. The matches stay in the user's matches. Pass 1 to 25 job_match_ids from getmattered_get_matches. Nothing is sent to any employer and nothing is spent. It can be undone with getmattered_save_matches. Do not use it to hide a match the user does not want; use getmattered_skip_matches. Next: getmattered_get_matches.

job_match_ids.description: Job match ids from getmattered_get_matches, 1 to 25 (e.g. [48213, 48214]).

name: getmattered_unsave_matches
